prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: north-star desktop composition for a local web application
Primary request: Create a high-fidelity 1440x900 desktop UI comp for Decision Covenant, a serious personal policy and evidence workspace. The user has explicitly delegated implementation choices after approving the structure.
Surface structure: a narrow deep-ink left navigation rail; a large central working canvas whose first viewport says "Make the decision process before the moment gets loud."; below it, a precise four-pack selector and three dense example rows; a selected example opens an integrated right-side inspection sheet showing the full fictional lifecycle and one primary action. The first screen must reveal purpose, a meaningful fictional example, and a clear action without showing a long blank form.
Selected content: "Evidence-first participation"; "Fictional walkthrough"; stages "Policy written", "Observation changed", "Condition ready for review", "Review recorded", "Cooldown"; actions "Use as my starting point" and secondary "Start blank".
Visual world: a modern 2026 decision review bench, not a literal laboratory, but borrowing the clarity of labeled assay trays and versioned protocols. Warm pale stone canvas, large deep navy or ink fields, precise saturated cobalt for current selection and primary action, restrained semantic amber, green, and red only for state. One highly readable contemporary grotesk with tabular numerals. Thin registration rules, clipped rectangular controls, very limited corner rounding, no generic card grid. Strong asymmetry, ample but purposeful whitespace, dense content where evidence is inspected. The selected lifecycle should feel like a state sequence laid across a review bench.
Signature interaction implied in still: selecting an example slides its labeled inspection sheet into the right column while pack and example context remain visible.
Style and medium: polished product design mockup, realistic browser UI, semantic and implementable in HTML and CSS.
Lighting and mood: calm daylight desk, consequential, precise, quietly confident.
Constraints: show clearly fictional data; no investment performance claims; no buy or sell recommendations; no charts pretending to be real; no remote imagery; no logos other than the product wordmark; controls must look familiar and accessible.
Avoid: rounded-card soup, pill navigation, glassmorphism, gradients, neon, crypto-dashboard tropes, broadsheet serif styling, giant empty hero, decorative finance photography, 2010 admin form aesthetics, excessive shadows, tiny unreadable text, watermark.
